title: Run AST Checks
summary: Runs drag-lint's AST-level checks against a file
intro: Read this when you want to validate a single file against drag-lint AST-level checks: you get the issues found in the parse tree, as text or JSON.

surfaces.caption: Run AST Checks
steps: Open the file in the editor
Open the About window (drag-lint > About) and click the Run AST Checks button
From a shell: `drag-lint check-ast <file> [--profile <name>] [--db PATH] [--rule <id>] [--format text|json]`

questions.ask: Does this file have AST-level issues?
